# Data Architecture Review

Use this skill when data is stored, transformed, integrated, reported, exported, audited, or retained.

## Procedure

1. Assign `DATA-###` and `REP-###`.
2. Capture source of truth, owner, classification, storage, transformation, lineage, retention, quality controls, consumers, and access controls.
3. Identify sensitive data and trigger security/privacy review.
4. Flag conflicting metric definitions or source systems.
5. Link data flows to integrations, controls, and ADRs.

**Why?** Data ownership and movement drive architecture risk.
